source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 21. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review. The surahs themselves are memorised with Dr. Hassan in class.
topic: Starting a lifelong habit of learning the Qur'an by heart

learn.en: Short surahs learnt by heart are among the first gifts of the Qur'an a young student receives.
learn.title: A precious gift

learn.en: We learn them page by page, together with our teacher, so every letter is said correctly.
learn.title: With your teacher

learn.en: “And recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.” (Qur'an 73:4)
learn.title: Slowly and beautifully

learn.en: A little every day is better than a lot once in a while. This is the start of a lifelong habit!
learn.title: A little every day

quiz.en: Who should we learn the surahs with, so we say every letter correctly?
True or false? A surah is a chapter of the Qur'an.

think.q: Which surah do you know by heart already? Can you recite it to Mum or Dad?
think.a: MashaAllah! Keep revising it every day.

parents.summary: Memorising short surahs with the teacher, a little every day. The surahs themselves are taught live by Dr. Hassan.
parents.tip: Ask him to recite the surah he is memorising before bed.
